<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center"><strong>WELCOME!</strong></h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center">Here you can register for booking one of the following Kite Services:</p>
<p class="has-text-align-center"><strong><a href="https://kitegeneration.com/kitesurfing-lessons-sardinia/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Kite Courses</a></strong>, <strong><a href="https://puntatrettukitesurfhouse.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Villa in Punta Trettu</a></strong>, and Kite Camp!</p>
<p>Before registering, please review our official prices and conditions on the <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/prices">KiteGeneration Price List page</a>, <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/prices">here</a>. Information from other pages, screenshots, or third-party sources are not valid / accepted.<strong> </strong></p>

</div>
<p class="has-text-align-center">Enjoy a fantastic experience  learning kitesurfing</p>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center"><a href="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/18W5l3fTMuNd5bhRqJzXd4q41LYW-Yh_5SYXvFS9ji7w/preview">KITE CAMP IN PUNTA TRETTU</a></h2>
<div class="wp-block-buttons is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-buttons-is-layout-a89b3969 wp-block-buttons-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-button"><a class="wp-block-button__link wp-element-button">BOOK YOUR KITE CAMP HERE</a></div>
</div>
<p>Kite Camps are organized in the following dates (kite camp could run if a minimimum of 4 participants will join): </p>
<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>May 2026: done</li>
<li>June 2026: done</li>
<li>July 2026 (high season): done</li>
<li>August 2026 (high season): 23 August (check in) &#8211; 28 August (check out)</li>
<li>September 2026: Not yet defined</li>
<li>October: Not yet defined</li>
</ul>
</div></div>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Main topics</strong></h3>
<ol class="wp-block-list">
<li><strong>Refund</strong>: Refunds of kitesurfing lessons are available in case of lack of wind (more information <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/terms-conditions/#main-topics">here</a>).</li>
<li><strong>Kite equipment included</strong>: All necessary kite equipment for the lessons (wetsuit, harnesses, helmet with radio, kitesurf, boarding) is provided by the kite school and included in the lesson price.</li>
<li><strong>Prices are per person</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Early booking discounts available</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Where we are</strong>: the headquarter of our kite school is <a href="https://g.page/puntatrettu?share" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"><strong>Punta Trettu</strong></a>, in the south west of Sardinia. To learn more about how our <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/kitesurfing-lessons-sardinia/">kite lessons</a> are conducted and how our <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/kitesurfing-lessons-sardinia/">kite school</a> operates, please visit the Kitesurfing Lessons in Sardinia, <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/kitesurfing-lessons-sardinia/">here</a>.</li>
<li><strong>We highly reccomend having a car!</strong> We strongly recommend renting a car, as it may be needed to explore other locations during non-lesson times or simply to reach markets, restaurants, and other amenities.</li>
<li><strong>Terms and Conditions</strong>: in order to avoid any kind of misunderstanding, have a look to our <a href="https://kitegeneration.com/terms-conditions/">Terms and Conditions.</a></li>
<li><strong>For multiple participants: </strong>If you are booking for more than one person, please fill out a separate form for each person. We require this information for all guests staying at our Kitesurf House (as per regulatory requirements) and for all participants in the kite lessons (both for compliance and to ensure proper lesson organization).</li>
<li><strong>Data accuracy:</strong> The information requested in the kite registration form is essential for organizing your kite service. Please ensure that all details you provide are accurate and correct.</li>
<li><strong>We can guarantee instructors that speak English or Italian</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Last-minute requests</strong>: We cannot guarantee availability for kite courses and kite camps for last-minute bookings. However, we will always do our best to find the best possible solution for you!</li>
</ol>
